newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher shares up on trade update.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher shares up on trade update.

text.p: Shares in retail group Kingfisher PLc rose on Wednesday after the company released a trading update showing like-for-like sales up 7.5 percent for the third quarter.
Shares were up 13-1/2 pence at 666 by 0825GMT, from Tuesday's close of 652-1/2p in active early morning trade.
Kingfisher said total sales rose 12.9 percent to 1.345 billion stg, with its three main retail chains B&Q, Comet and Woolworths achieving double digit growth.
The market reacted quickly, pushing Kingfisher shares higher despite the overall FTSE 100 easing and a similar picture in the New York stock market.
"Obviously the markets were pleased with the figures," said Nick Bubb of MeesPierson, "Although I thought they were slightly disappointing -- I expected sales to be up nine or 10 percent."
Later, the surge in Kingfisher eased up slightly, with shares trading at 663 pence by 0900GMT.
"The share price will do well to hold its level," said Bubb, adding that he doubted most analysts would be changing their forecasts, which already predicted good full year results."
